name: Alliance Cable and Wire Harness
old_description: DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT, AND MANUFACTURING FOR ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY
about:
Alliance Cable & Wire Harness was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Lindon, Utah. The company is led by President and CEO Cole Matson, supported by Vice Presidents Edd Todd and Sergio Martinez and Board Advisor Chad London, who collectively bring decades of wire harness industry experience.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies, offering services that span rapid prototyping, turnkey assembly, overmolding, kitting, drop shipping, and full design validation testing. Its facility operates equipment such as Komax cut-strip-crimp machines, Tesonic ultrasonic splicers, vertical injection molding presses, and Formlabs 3D printers, enabling both low‑to‑medium volume, high‑mix production and high‑volume runs.

Alliance serves customers in oil and gas, robotics and sensors, solar photovoltaics, transportation, audio and video, general electronics, instrumentation, and medical markets, including Fortune 500 companies across the United States and Canada.

The company emphasizes a boutique manufacturing model built for agility, citing quick turnaround on design and product, vendor‑managed inventory and consignment programs, on‑site prototyping, and long‑term after‑market support as key differentiators.

name: Alloy Welding and Manufacturing Co., Inc.
old_description: We are a job shop with 85 years of experience in metal fabrication, placing the highest priority on quality workmanship and customer service.
about:
Alloy Welding & Manufacturing Co., Inc. operates from Bristol, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1937 by Delphis “Del” Frechette. The company began as a job shop producing fabricated metal parts and welding repairs for local industry, with Del designing and building much of its original equipment. The business remained operational through World War II and survived the 1955 Bristol flood before relocating to its current address. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the firm is led by Darren Frechette, who assumed management in 2005.

The shop provides metal fabrication, welding (GTAW, GMAW, SMAW), waterjet cutting, handheld laser welding, and portable welding services, along with metal sales and design assistance. Its 14,000-square-foot facility houses a CNC water jet for versatile shape cutting and a handheld laser welder suited for thin materials such as stainless steel and titanium. The company handles fabrication, installation, and repair projects for a range of part sizes, though specific production volumes are not disclosed.

Customers span industrial manufacturers, schools, government agencies, hospitals, apartment complexes, military entities, general contractors, and individual clients. The company serves sectors including construction, medical, high-tech, and military, and deploys mobile welding trucks for on-site maintenance and repair work.

Alloy Welding emphasizes quality workmanship and customer service, maintaining an ISO 9001:2015 quality system and requiring OSHA-10 certification for all technicians. The firm promotes “precision parts without a premium price” and highlights quick turnarounds, a commitment to answering the phone directly, and a family-business culture intended to continue into a fourth generation.

Quick turnarounds on fabrication and welding jobs
ISO 9001:2015 quality system with OSHA-10 certified technicians
Mobile welding trucks for on-site repairs
CNC water jet and handheld laser welder for thin materials

name: Alpine Consulting & Metal Works
old_description: Since our establishment in 2018, Alpine Consulting & Metal Works (ACMW) has been a trusted provider of custom metal fabrication, engineering solutions, and process consulting. Founded by Joseph Poulin, a seasoned professional with a BS in Mechanical Engineering Technology from the University of Maine at Orono, ACMW has built a reputation for delivering precision, innovation, and unmatched quality to a wide range of industries.
about:
Alpine Consulting & Metal Works was founded in 2018 by Joseph Poulin in Oakland, Maine. Poulin, who holds a BS in Mechanical Engineering Technology from the University of Maine at Orono, established the company to provide custom metal fabrication, engineering solutions, and process consulting.

The shop delivers structural steel fabrication, welding (including AWS-certified FCAW), and industrial, mechanical, and pipe fabrication. It also offers engineering support, project management, and fabrication software consulting for platforms such as STSX and Tekla PowerFab. Projects have ranged from 500‑pound custom jobs to 4,000‑ton structural builds.

Customers include steel fabrication firms such as Cherokee Steel Inc. (Watertown, TN) and Ennis Steel (Ennis, TX), along with other industrial and mechanical contractors seeking process optimization and on‑site field engineering. The company serves a broad base of structural steel, industrial fabrication, and pipe fabrication sectors.

ACMW emphasizes a seamless customer experience backed by Poulin’s hands‑on background from shop floor to engineering leadership. The firm differentiates itself by offering versatile solutions — whether on the shop floor, in the office, or on‑site as a field engineer — and by guiding clients in streamlining workflows through fabrication software consulting.

name: Altek Electronics Inc (A Cyient DLM Company)
old_description: In addition to being the founder of Altek Company, a manufacturer of can testing equipment for the food and beverage industry under the name of Tech® Products, Steve is also the founder of Altek Electronics. Stephen graduated from UConn with a Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, and earned a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from Yale University. Earlier in his career, Mr. Altschuler was Vice President of Computer Dynamics (1963-72) and Manager of Quality Assurance for Adage Inc. (1959-63). He served on the Board of Trustees for the University of Connecticut from 1986-93 and is the former Director and Vice President of the Northwestern Connecticut Chamber of Commerce. In 1972 Steve established Altek, and for 50 years worked to create and maintain a business culture that emphasizes customer satisfaction. Stephen has worked successfully with his team to: create a loyal customer base; maintain a profitable business operation that pays its bills on time; and earn a solid reputation in the industry.
about:
Altek Electronics Inc., now operating as a Cyient DLM company, is headquartered in Torrington, Connecticut. The business was founded in 1972 by Stephen Altschuler, an electrical engineer with degrees from the University of Connecticut and Yale University. Altschuler previously held leadership roles at Computer Dynamics and Adage Inc. before establishing Altek to serve the electronics assembly market. The company remains under the leadership of the Altschuler family, with David Altschuler serving as chief executive officer.

The firm provides full-service electronics manufacturing, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, BGA placement, selective and wave soldering, wire and cable harness fabrication, conformal coating, and box-build system integration. Operations are supported by equipment such as the ERSA Versaflow 3/66 selective soldering system, a PVA6000 conformal coating machine with IR2000 curing oven, and automated component counting and barcode traceability systems. The facility employs more than 130 people and handles programs ranging from prototype runs to full-rate production.

Altek serves original equipment manufacturers in the medical, aerospace, defense, telecommunications, industrial/commercial, and transportation sectors. The company was an early adopter of AS9100, achieving “C” level certification and later upgrading to the “D” revision in April 2017. Its quality system is also certified to ISO 9001, ISO 13485 for medical devices, and IATF 16949 for automotive, and it maintains ITAR registration for defense-related work.

Altschuler’s founding philosophy centered on customer satisfaction, on-time bill payment, and a reputation for reliability. The company states it is dedicated to offering the highest quality electronics at the most competitive price without compromising its core beliefs, a principle that has guided its growth over five decades.

name: Aluf Plastics
old_description: As a global manufacturer of compostable sealant, barrier sealant films, and laminates, we serve a diverse range of industries including food, beverage, medical, personal care, office, industrial, and other consumer packaged goods (CPG) segments.
about:
Earthfirst Films, a division of Aluf Plastics, is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with additional manufacturing sites in Orangeburg, New York, and Sulphur Springs, Texas. The business traces its roots to 1949 when Joe Tatem founded Plastic Suppliers as a privately held corporation in Blackwood, New Jersey. Over decades the company expanded through distribution centers and converting facilities across the United States and Europe, eventually establishing film manufacturing in Columbus in 1974. In 2025 the Earthfirst Films brand was acquired by API, continuing its focus on sustainable packaging.

The company manufactures compostable sealant films, barrier sealant films, and laminates using blown film extrusion and cast-and-tenter extrusion technologies. Its Columbus campus operates a blown film facility and a tenter film facility supported by an on-site laboratory equipped with two lab extruders for tensile, barrier, FTIR, and microscopy testing. Capabilities include lamination, high-speed slitting, converting, and fast prototyping with small-batch production runs.

Earthfirst Films serves the food, beverage, medical, personal care, office, industrial, and broader consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors. Its films are used in applications such as flow wrap, shrink sleeve decoration, and print web structures, targeting brands that require certified home-compostable or industrial-compostable packaging solutions.

The company states its mission is to create sustainable solutions through open collaboration. It highlights a legacy of over 20 years in biopolymer film extrusion, holding several patents on compostable sealant films, and offering materials beyond PLA, including PHA and other biobased polymers. The 2019 SQF certification for its blown film facility underscores a commitment to food-grade packaging standards.

name: Amark Wire
old_description: For over 50 years, Amark Wire has been a recognized leader in the custom manufacturing of wires, pins, and cables. We specialize in smaller, more difficult products that are used across many different industries and in some of the most critical applications.
about:
Based in Fairfield, New Jersey, Amark Wire has spent more than five decades as a specialist in the custom manufacture of wires, pins, and cables. The company focuses on smaller, technically demanding components that serve critical applications across multiple sectors.

Its capabilities span drawing, grinding, straightening, cutting, forming, and spooling of small-diameter wire rod, holding tolerances from 0.002 inch to 0.250 inch in diameter and lengths up to 12 feet. The shop runs Escomatic Swiss screw machines, four-slide equipment, centerless grinders, wire EDM, and a range of secondary operations including flattening, heading, precision bending, sand blasting, tumbling, upsetting, threading, and cold forming.

Customers come from automotive, aerospace, defense, dental, medical, electrical, fiber optics, glass sealing, and earth and environmental sciences. The firm supplies conductors, drawn wire, electrical pins, electrodes, eyelets, hermetically sealed pins, guide wire, hinge pins, inserts, micro welding wire, rods, shafts, springs, step pins, studs, stylets, thermocouple wire, and tubing.

Amark Wire emphasizes domestic production — all materials and products are manufactured in the USA — and promotes fast turnaround times and competitive pricing as key differentiators. Original material certifications and test reports are maintained on file, and customer drawings are kept confidential.

name: American Alloy Fabrication Inc
old_description: American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) has been serving customers with metal fabricated components for more than 35 years. Our success is a result of our continued investment in the latest manufacturing technologies as well as our aggressive focus on quality, lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement.
about:
American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) began in 1980 as a one‑man welding shop in Huntsville, Alabama, founded to serve local industries with precision welding services.

By 1987 the company had incorporated and moved into a new facility that has since been expanded multiple times. Today AAFI operates as a vertically integrated contract manufacturer offering sheet metal fabrication (laser cutting, CNC turret punching, CNC forming), CNC and manual machining, welding (MIG, TIG, spot, robotic), metal finishing, deburring, polishing, mechanical assembly, and packaging, crating and logistics support. The shop also provides design‑for‑manufacturability assistance, prototype development, production manufacturing and complete project management.

The company’s customer base spans diverse industries; its first major contract came from a local engine manufacturer that needed a reusable shipping rack, a project that launched AAFI into large‑scale contract manufacturing. Since then the firm has supplied fabricated parts, industrial enclosures, custom weldments and mechanical assemblies to a range of industrial clients.

AAFI emphasizes continuous investment in advanced manufacturing technology and a quality system that consistently achieves above 95 % acceptance and on‑time delivery. Inspection capabilities include coordinate measuring machines, optical comparators and laser scanners. The company’s stated goal is to build long‑term partnerships by acting as an extension of its customers’ organizations.

name: American Auto Parts
old_description: Dan has been with American Auto Parts since 2001. For the past 15 years Dan has experienced all facets of the Parts sales side of the business from Outside sales to Management and so on. Dan specializes in Part sales and Service. Dan has over 35 years of extensive experience in Auto, Light Truck, Foreign and Domestic parts from drive train to chassis and suspension. Dan wants everyone to know he is ready to serve.
about:
American Auto Parts operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility on five acres at 1807 North 16th Street in Omaha, Nebraska. The company has served the greater Omaha area for more than 50 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed; long-time staff members Dan (with the company since 2001, 35 years industry experience) and Mark (since 2000, 19 years experience) are highlighted as parts specialists.

The business supplies domestic and foreign used, remanufactured, aftermarket, and new OEM surplus auto parts. Inventory spans engines, transmissions, doors, radiators, differentials, transfer cases, tires, and wheels. The company offers a parts locator service, coast-to-coast shipping within the continental United States (airbags excluded), local delivery, and 24/7 online purchasing through an eBay storefront.

Customers include fellow automotive recyclers, independent garages, collision repair shops, and individual vehicle owners. The company positions itself as a resource for both trade buyers and retail consumers seeking foreign and domestic light-truck and passenger-car components.

American Auto Parts emphasizes its extensive on-hand inventory, fast parts technicians, knowledgeable sales staff, and a delivery service described as unbeatable. The combination of a large physical yard, nationwide shipping, and round-the-clock digital access is presented as the core value proposition.

old_description: Believe in better results with American Bean. We are a company founded on the principle that quality products mean increased yields and higher profitability for our customers, growers, and buyers alike. From the farm to the fork, our products are held to a higher standard through each step of our process to ensure the highest quality and value driven results with every bean.
about:
American Bean operates from its headquarters in Petersburg, North Dakota, with additional facilities in Angus and Oslo, Minnesota, and Sharon, North Dakota. The company was founded on the principle that quality seed products drive higher yields and profitability for growers and buyers, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in producing and packaging a wide variety of dry bean certified seed, including pinto and cranberry beans. Its grower network adheres to rigorous standards to ensure seed quality, and the company's food safety program is audited and certified under the Primus GFS standard, an internationally recognized GFSI benchmark. American Bean also holds HACCP certification.

American Bean serves agricultural growers seeking certified seed for planting, as well as buyers and food processors worldwide who require high-quality dry beans. Its customer base includes farmers planning seasonal seeding and international buyers sourcing dry beans for food production.

The company states it was founded on the principle that quality products mean increased yields and higher profitability for customers, growers, and buyers alike, and that its products are held to a higher standard through each step of the process from farm to fork.
